title: Actor's Warm-Up
subtitle: Voice teacher classics — the cork edition
description: These are the exercises that acting coaches and vocal trainers have used for generations to warm up the articulation of professional performers. Done with a cork, they become a powerhouse drill for every muscle involved in speech.
tip: Say each phrase with intention and exaggerated mouth movement — the cork is helping you build the habit of full articulation that actors train for years.
phrases: The lips the teeth the tip of the tongue
A proper cup of coffee from a proper copper coffee pot
Mixed biscuits mixed biscuits mixed biscuits
Knapsack straps knapsack straps knapsack straps
Whether the weather is warm whether the weather is hot
